cases.sentence: Елеуй, сын Барахела, потомок Буза из рода ___.
cases.translation: Elihu, the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram.
cases.explain: Genealogical constructions use the genitive case to show family lineage.

cases.sentence: Он разгневался на Иова за то, что тот считал себя праведным перед ___.
cases.translation: He became angry at Job because Job considered himself righteous before God.
cases.explain: The preposition 'перед' (before) governs the instrumental case to show position.

cases.sentence: Но Елеуй ждал, прежде чем заговорить с ___, потому что остальные были старше его.
cases.translation: But Elihu waited before speaking with Job, because the others were older than he.
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я молод годами, вы же в преклонных ___, поэтому я и рабел.
cases.translation: I am young in years, but you are in advanced age, therefore I was afraid.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) indicating time or state governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Но нет, это дух в человеке, и дыхание всемогущего разум дают в ___.
cases.translation: But it is the spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives understanding to the aged.
cases.explain: The indirect object of 'дают' (give) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я ждал, пока вы говорили, суждение ваше слушал, пока вы искали ___.
cases.translation: I waited while you spoke, I listened to your judgment, while you searched for words.
cases.explain: The direct object of 'искали' (searched for) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я вглядывался в вас, но никто из вас Иова не опроверг, но нет ___ в устах его.
cases.translation: I looked at you, but none of you refuted Job, but there was no answer in his mouth.
cases.explain: The negation 'нет' (there is no) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я переполнен ___ дух во мне побуждает меня.
cases.translation: I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
cases.explain: The adjective 'переполнен' (full) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Так эти трое друзей Иова перестали спорить с ним, потому что он считал себя праведным.
reading.question: Why did the three friends stop arguing with Job?
options: They had other matters to attend to
reading.explain: The text says the three friends ceased answering because Job considered himself righteous in his own eyes.

reading.ru: Elihu was angry at Job because Job justified himself rather than God, and angry at his three friends because they had found no answer yet condemned Job.
reading.question: What did Elihu think about Job's defense?
options: Job was right to justify himself
Job was wrong to justify himself instead of God
Job did not need to defend himself
reading.correct: Job was wrong to justify himself instead of God
reading.explain: Elihu's wrath was kindled because Job justified himself rather than God, showing disapproval of Job's position.

reading.ru: Я думал, пусть говорит возраст, пусть преклонные годы учат мудрости.
reading.question: What was Elihu's initial assumption about wisdom?
options: Age and old age should teach wisdom
reading.correct: Age and old age should teach wisdom
reading.explain: Elihu initially believed that age and advanced years should teach wisdom, which is why he held back.

reading.ru: Не одни старики мудры, не одни престарелые знают правду, поэтому говорю я, внимайте мне, я тоже скажу вам, что знаю.
reading.question: What realization did Elihu come to?
options: Not only the old are wise; young people also have wisdom
reading.correct: Not only the old are wise; young people also have wisdom
reading.explain: Elihu declares that it is not only the great or aged who are wise, and therefore he says he will also share his opinion.

reading.ru: Не буду смотреть ни на чье лицо и льстить никому не стану, ведь я не умею льстить, иначе скоро убил бы меня мой творец.
reading.question: What is Elihu promising about his speech?
options: He will not show favor to anyone or flatter
reading.correct: He will not show favor to anyone or flatter
reading.explain: Elihu explicitly says he will not respect any man's person or give flattering titles, as he cannot flatter lest his Maker take him away.

reading.ru: Сердце мое, как вино неоткрытое, как новые бурдюки, готовые разорваться.
reading.question: What does Elihu compare his emotional state to?
options: Unopened wine and new wineskins ready to burst
reading.correct: Unopened wine and new wineskins ready to burst
reading.explain: Elihu says his heart is like unopened wine and new wineskins ready to burst, expressing his need to speak.
